summary: Found six root causes in the CI logs (settings shared-state, putaway hash-order tie, export spool temp-file, local-timezone today(), month-end review date, rate cache key) and fixed them in stockroom/, plus a few latent doc mismatches (review_day validation, transfer qty, exact billable weight, strict regexes). Tests pass across timezones, orders, hash seeds and month-end dates; 2.6.0-only unit failures and operator cancels are not filed.
